title: Continuous Adversarial Flow Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.11521v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose continuous adversarial flow models, a type of continuous-time flow model trained with an adversarial objective. Unlike flow matching, which uses a fixed mean-squared-error criterion, our approach introduces a learned discriminator to guide training. This change in objective induces a different generalized distribution, which empirically produces samples that are better aligned with the target data distribution. Our method is primarily proposed for post-training existing flow-matching models, although it can also train models from scratch. On the ImageNet 256px generation task, our post-training substantially improves the guidance-free FID of latent-space SiT from 8.26 to 3.63 and of pixel-space JiT from 7.17 to 3.57. It also improves guided generation, reducing FID from 2.06 to 1.53 for SiT and from 1.86 to 1.80 for JiT. We further evaluate our approach on text-to-image generation, where it achieves improved results on bot

translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.11521v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们提出了连续对抗流模型，这是一种使用对抗目标训练的连续时间流模型。与使用固定均方误差准则的流匹配不同，我们的方法引入了一个学习的判别器来指导训练。这一目标的变化导致了不同的广义分布，经验上产生的样本与目标数据分布更好地对齐。我们的方法主要用于对现有流匹配模型进行后训练，尽管它也可以从头训练模型。在ImageNet 256px生成任务上，我们的后训练显著改善了潜在空间SiT的无指导FID从8.26降至3.63，像素空间JiT从7.17降至3.57。它还改善了指导生成，将SiT的FID从2.06降至1.53，JiT从1.86降至1.80。我们进一步评估了我们的方法在文本到图像生成上的表现，它在bot上取得了改进的结果。
tldr: 本文提出连续对抗流模型，通过引入判别器改变训练目标，显著提升流匹配模型在图像生成任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes continuous adversarial flow models, which introduce a discriminator to change the training objective, significantly improving the performance of flow matching models on image generation tasks.
